items.title: George Masso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: But I do some things with the Artie Shaw band, led by Dick Johnson, who is a very close friend of mine, and we live in the same area. So I go out with him occasionally and do things.

ctx.x: I forget the fellow — the fellow who’s leading it now is a trombone player.

Yes. I met him recently, I can’t recall his name. But I do some things with the Artie Shaw band, led by Dick Johnson, who is a very close friend of mine, and we live in the same area. So I go out with him occasionally and do things. And once place we were playing they had two bands, the other band was the Jimmy Dorsey band.
Right now in your career, do you pick and choose what you want to do a little more than before?
